Everytime you as an artist throw your artwork out there, you're going to get positive and negative feedback from it. All because of whether or not your work fits the viewers taste.

posts.name: Under3
posts.cooked:
The base set art in particular is very patchy in quality, and unfortunately doesn’t remotely compare to professional comic artwork. Look at something like Shielding Winds or most of Tachyon’s deck, it’s just a scribbly mess.
Sure, you can argue taste is subjective, but you can also analyse general quality, and when Sentinels started in regards to the art you can state that quality wasn’t there compared to the art we get now, or when compared to other comic book based games.
So, while there is a lot I like about it, and I really do love a lot of it, I can definitely understand why people would be put off by it and don’t think it’s something to get annoyed by.
